requirements.title: Procedure pointer initialization defines initial association status and implies SAVE
requirements.source: 15.4.3.6 p6 association sentences; J3/24-007 PDF p333.
requirements.definition: An initializer in proc-decl specifies initial association status for the procedure entity, implies SAVE, makes => NULL() initially disassociated, and makes => initial-proc-target initially associated with the target.

pending.initializer-specifies-initial-associatio: PENDING module source with p_null => NULL() and p_target => target_fun; check ASSOCIATED(p_null) is false from a logical sentinel .true. and p_target(3) returns literal 30.

pending.null-init-initially-disassociated: PENDING source initializes logical seen=.true., evaluates ASSOCIATED(p_null) into seen for PROCEDURE(integer_unary), POINTER :: p_null => NULL(), and expects seen=.false. before any pointer assignment.
pending.initial-target-associated: PENDING source PROCEDURE(integer_unary), POINTER :: p => target_fun where target_fun returns n+100; calling p(8) changes integer sentinel -77 to 108.
pending.initial-target-invocation-observable: PENDING mutation plan changes only the initializer target from target_fun returning 108 to other_fun returning 208; oracle expects the call through p to distinguish the initialized target.

requirements.oracle: Association is observed only through ASSOCIATED for NULL() or by invoking a defined associated target that returns a literal sentinel. The SAVE plan uses two calls to the same subprogram instance sequence to avoid default-state vacuity.
